notes.title: Major update - Controller support and Japanese localization
notes.content:
Hello rewinders,

We've been paying close attention to your needs for controller support, and now we're happy to announce that we've fully adapted and optimized for controller players. Also, we are preparing for Steam Deck compatibility check.

It's worth mentioning that The Rewinder is available on Nintendo Switch today. In order to ensure the same language support on both ends, Japanese localization is also included in this update. And we hope our Japanese players can enjoy Chinese unique ghost and demon culture.

Last but not least, thank you for all the support and comments all these time!

tags.feature: We've been paying close attention to your needs for controller support, and now we're happy to announce that we've fully adapted and optimized for controller players.
Japanese localization is also included in this update.

notes.title: 1.27.0 English localization update & other patch notes
notes.content:
A major localization update! We asked a native speaker to polish all English texts: Major thanks to Dana who did tons of edits, obsessed over typos and display issues, and wrote some brand-new poems for the flower hints! 

So if you had hesitations about the translation quality before, we hope this update will improve the experience for English players. If you catch any other localization problems in the English version, be sure to let us know.

Other small bug fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed some issues of characters bouncing from the ground in certain scenes
[*] Added an exit button to the "stone" screens in the cave
[*] Fixed some camera issues
[*] Fixed some issues with display ratios
[/list]

[list]
[*] Improved "petting the dog" animation!
[*] Added a hint for autosaving
[*] Improved the hint for QTE
[*] Improved mouse navigation for the mountain maze puzzle
[*] Improved the background display for the mountain scene
[*] You can now use esc to exit puzzle screens
[*] You can now drag to use inventory objects
[/list]

notes.title: 1.26.9 Patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Mac users can now unlock new achievements - for players who have already finished the game, you should be able to get most story achievements retroactively just by loading into the karma stone scene. A few achievements that requires you to perform a certain action (such as "petting the dog") might require replaying to unlock.
[*] Fixed menu page animations.
[*] Fixed the issue of the "Mr. Black" clause not unlocking in the book.
[*] Fixed the issue of Ming's character shaking in the secret ending.
[*] Fixed the issue of some players getting stuck in the portal.
[*] Improved tutorial for the spider cave puzzle.
[/list]

P.S. Players reported the issue of cloud save not working. We are aware of the issue and are currently working to fix it. Meanwhile if you need to find your local save file, you can do so here: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\MistyMountainStudio\Rewinder

And another note: By VERY POPULAR demand, we now updated the OST to include the villagers's orchestra music - "Awaken the Heavens". Players who already own The Rewinder Original Soundtrack should be able to see it after an update. We also added WAV files for all the tracks if you are looking for higher sound quality!
